recommendedCandidates.name: The Fourth Lock
recommendedCandidates.summary: Fall River restaurant and bar offering dine-in and pickup, with seafood, pizza, burgers and other dinner dishes.
recommendedCandidates.ownershipEvidence: The Shubenacadie Canal Commission's location-specific November 23, 2022 interview identifies co-owner Jaro Schubert, his move to Fall River and founding the restaurant. Present-day first-party site and its 2026 menu continue the same restaurant identity. This establishes a local independent origin and continuing same-brand operation; it does not independently audit unchanged legal ownership in 2026.
recommendedCandidates.ownershipConfidence: medium-high; local co-owner interview is dated 2022
recommendedCandidates.operationEvidence: Current official homepage explicitly offers dine-in and pickup Wednesday-Sunday from 4:30pm, links a 2026 summer menu PDF, owner-linked Clover ordering and table reservations. Provincial tourism corroborates exact address and restaurant identity.
fieldCaveats: This is Fall River, not Waverley proper. Do not relabel it to fill the Waverley gap.
Owner homepage explicitly says closing hours depend on business volume and the kitchen usually stays open until 9pm. Do not turn 'usually' into a fixed daily closing time.
Menu PDF is the owner's currently linked 2026 Summer Menu; do not label its prices or seasonal dishes as a guaranteed October menu.
No named 2026 ownership-register confirmation obtained; preserve the 2022 provenance rather than claiming a fresh legal ownership audit.
One restaurant record only. The B&B at the same address is not an additional restaurant.
Phone withheld: visible homepage text 902-861-4454 conflicts with its own JSON-LD and malformed tel link 902-861-1334, also used by tourism. Do not choose one without resolution.
Coordinates come explicitly from the named business location in the fresh owner Wix SEO context and match its exact civic address; no coordinates were invented.

heldCandidates.name: Encore and Oliver's Gastropub at Inn on the Lake
heldCandidates.newFinding: Owner's site establishes exact location, two dining-room names, a May 2026 Mother's Day dining offer, and independent operation effective April 1, 2025. Its property-history page attributes the inn to Ron and Susan Nelson; current contact names different managers and a 2026 guest reports an ownership change. The guest report is not authoritative proof of a sale, but current local ownership should be reconciled before promoting a historical attribution.
heldCandidates.nextEvidenceNeeded: Contemporary owner/operator statement, and a decision whether the two dining areas are one restaurant identity or genuinely distinct operations. Do not double count the inn.
